desc:
A monthly ecommerce SEO starter plan gives your store a first month of steady, focused work and a plain report on what changed. Ecom Swift LLC sets up tracking, improves your most useful pages and shows you the results in simple words.

## What is a monthly ecommerce SEO starter plan?

A monthly ecommerce SEO starter plan is a first month of structured search work on your store, packaged with a report. It is a sprint, not a subscription. We check your tracking, choose the pages worth improving, carry out the first round of changes and then tell you what we did.

After that month, you decide what comes next. Ongoing monthly care is quoted separately, so you are never locked in by buying the first sprint.

## Why start with a sprint instead of a long contract

SEO is easier to judge once you have seen the work. A sprint lets you check how we communicate, what the changes look like and whether the report is useful, before you commit to anything longer. It also produces real improvements right away, since the first month usually holds the easiest wins.

Many store owners have been burned by agencies that charge monthly and send charts nobody can read. A short, clear first month avoids that. You see the pages touched, the fixes made and the data behind them.

## How steady SEO work affects traffic and sales

Search visibility grows from many small, correct changes added together: better titles, clearer product text, fewer technical faults, stronger links between pages and a few new helpful articles. Each one on its own is modest. Together they make more of your catalog easy for search engines to find and easy for shoppers to understand.

The first month starts that process and gives you a baseline. Tracking set up properly means that later changes in traffic can be tied to real work. Search results move slowly and depend on competitors and past history, so we report changes honestly and make no promise of page one positions.

## What a good first month includes

- Search Console and analytics checked, so the data you rely on is correct.
- A review of where the store stands today.
- The most useful pages picked by potential, not by guess.
- Page titles, descriptions and text improved on those pages.
- A set of quick technical fixes, such as broken links or missing tags.
- Internal links added to point toward key pages.
- New helpful content, where the package includes it.
- A baseline snapshot of traffic and positions.
- A short written report, and in the largest package a call.

## How the sprint runs

We begin with tracking, because nothing else can be measured without it. We then review your store and pick the pages with the best balance of potential and effort. Changes are made inside your own store, and we keep a record of old and new text.

The Basic package improves a small group of pages, makes a few quick technical fixes and ends with a one page report. The Standard package covers more pages and fixes, adds one new article or guide, builds internal links and includes a ranking and traffic snapshot. The Premium package goes wider, adds two articles and a small round of safe outreach, then closes with a plan for the following three months and a report call.

Add-ons include an extra article, more pages improved and a competitor snapshot.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Give us your priorities, such as the products that earn you the most.
- Approve changes quickly, so work does not stall.
- Keep Search Console and analytics running after the sprint.
- Go through the report and ask us about any point that is not clear.
- Allow several weeks before judging the results.

**Avoid:**
- Expecting overnight changes in rankings.
- Changing your theme or product names mid-sprint.
- Judging success on one day of traffic.
- Paying for long contracts before seeing real work.
- Ignoring the baseline, since later progress is measured against it.

## Who this service is for

A store owner who knows SEO matters but has never started will find this the easiest entry. A seller who tried tools alone and stalled can hand over the first push. A business weighing a longer agency relationship can use the month as a low-risk trial.

It also suits owners who want a baseline before a bigger investment.

## What we need from you

Send your store address, a short description of your best-selling products and any goals you have. Please add us as a user on Search Console and analytics, and as a collaborator or staff user in your store so we can apply the changes. We never ask for your passwords. We will confirm what we need in a short checklist when you order.
